_comment: PUBLISHER: to ship Google sign-in so end users never create their own OAuth client, create ONE OAuth client (Desktop app) in Google Cloud, download its JSON, and save it next to this file as 'google_client.json' (same folder). It is bundled into the build and used automatically; end users then only click Connect. Leave absent to let each user paste their own client in the GUI. Never commit the real google_client.json.
